IncidentDef.label: Merchants in distress amidst the snowstorm
IncidentDef.letterText:
A person who appeared to be a businessman struggled and struggled to reach this point, but he no longer had the strength to continue moving forward.
The wind and snow are about to engulf his last life force, and the goods he carries will also be buried in the wind and snow with him.

Unless someone loves wealth more than life.

IncidentDef.label: Unicorn in the wind and snow
IncidentDef.letterLabel: Unicorn in the wind and snow
IncidentDef.letterText:
A massive percussion beast arrived here, seemingly eager to find a place to shelter from the blizzard, and ultimately chose your colony.

In order to stay in your colony, this percussion beast has been domesticated on its own and has made efforts to appear obedient. Perhaps taking it in would be a good idea.

Just don't let it enter your barn.

IncidentDef.label: Signal tower collapse
IncidentDef.letterText: A signal tower in the distance emitted flashes of strong light, followed by a loud bang and then no more sound. These signal towers, which have been in disrepair for many years, are not reliable in themselves, so their damage seems so natural in such extreme snowstorms.\n\nNo one will try to repair the signal tower in this kind of snowstorm. The communication station can only resume normal operation after the snowstorm.

IncidentDef.label: Animals Escape
IncidentDef.letterText: Perhaps sensing some warning signs, the animals began to flee from this area.

IncidentDef.label: Snow Dog Migration
IncidentDef.letterText: A small group of Huskies are rushing in one direction, perhaps intending to return to their own tribe before the next snowstorm.

IncidentDef.label: Windstorm Cultists
IncidentDef.letterText: A group of believers who kept chanting loudly came to this place. They will endlessly praise the 'God of Wind and Snow' in their mouths, without caring whether it will disturb your colonizers, until they voluntarily leave or are driven away by you.\n\nThis group of believers regards Windstorm Crystals as a gift from the God of Wind and Snow, so if you have Windstorm Crystals, they will be very willing to purchase them.
